approvals.summary: Consent valid for rewards-personalization scope. No prohibited data or protected attributes accessed.
Candidate-1 successfully implements the multi-goal requirement with 8 rich components, perfectly addressing Sarah Chen's 3 active savings goals.
No dark patterns, artificial scarcity, or manipulative urgency detected. Consent and purpose limitations fully respected.
Card-based layout is fully accessible, clear, and respects cognitive load guidelines.

Mandatory POINTS_BALANCE included as priority 1. All real customer data (Japan Vacation, New Phone, Emergency Fund, 6820 coins, Platinum tier) correctly populated without placeholders or dark patterns.
Layout spans correctly configured with half-span goal cards and add-goal cards forming balanced 2-column rows, and full-span hero and summary components.
All 9 validation checks passed successfully. SDUI payload is approved for release.
